notes:
Top-line: incumbent archive search is slow for long-form assets (video transcripts + scripts). Want RAG-style QA + citeable passages.
- Data: ~8-12M content items (articles, transcripts, captions); average raw doc length 4-8k chars, many >30k (multi-episode transcripts).
- Current infra: homegrown Elastic cluster with keyword-only retrieval; embeddings pilot with small Pinecone index but reranker not integrated.
- Goals: reduce human search time, support legal/rights discovery, surface exact clip passages.
- Latency targets: 95th pctile search response <300ms for recall pipeline (ANN+rerank) — ideally <200ms for simple queries. Reranker tail target <400ms when running cross-encoder on CPU is unacceptable.
- Throughput: steady-state 120 qps, occasional spikes to 400 qps during newsroom hours.
- Cost: finance target ~<$0.01 per query (end-to-end avg); open to higher for rare legal audits.
- Index cadence: nightly full crawl + hourly deltas. Want near-real-time ingestion for breaking news (sub-5m).
- Chunking: experimenting with sentence-boundary vs sliding-window (chunk overlap 25-50%). Concern: too small chunks break context for reranker; too-large chunks blow embedding cost.
- Reranker: preference for cross-encoder style (GPU) for top-20 results; interested in two-stage: cheap bi-encoder filtering then cross-encoder re-score. Need guidance on top-k tradeoffs for cost vs quality.
- Models: prefer open/verified models (on-prem friendly). Avoid blackbox SaaS for PII content.
- Security: must support corporate SSO, audit logs for query access, and EU residency for EU content.
- Quote from Head of Search: "If we can't trust highlights to point to the exact clip, newsroom editors won't adopt it."
- Artifacts: POC ingestion script, sample transcripts (anonymized), evaluation prompt set (500 Qs), cost worksheet (attached).
- CRM shorthand: SE call 2/28 — reranker perf looks promising on 8k sample; follow-up to test batch vs streaming KB cache.

requirements_summary: Enterprise RAG search over very long documents. Must support high-quality embeddings at scale (8-12M items), configurable chunking with overlap heuristics, two-stage retrieval+rerank (bi-encoder ANN -> cross-encoder GPU reranker), low-latency SLOs for newsroom UX, per-query cost targets, EU residency and SSO/KMS. Need clear guidance from Redwood on embedding model selection, chunk sizing experiments, reranker top-k tuning, and autoscaling for burst traffic.
